environment.description: Same NestJS microservice deployed on an EKS pod with a custom AppArmor profile loaded via annotation container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/webhook-svc=localhost/k8s-webhook-restricted. The profile (k8s-webhook-restricted) uses a deny-by-default posture with explicit allow rules: it permits network inet stream connections but applies a capability restriction denying net_raw. File write operations are confined to /tmp/webhook_cache/** with owner-only permissions enforced (owner mediation). The profile includes 'deny /proc/*/environ r,' and 'deny /var/run/secrets/** r,' rules. Additionally, the node's kubelet is configured with --cloud-provider=external and the pod spec sets hostNetwork: false. The instance uses IMDSv2 with hop-limit=1, meaning the metadata service requires a PUT-based token acquisition that cannot traverse the pod's network namespace boundary due to the TTL constraint on the containerized network stack.
